WITH budget_with_event AS (
  SELECT b.budget_id, b.spent, b.amount, e.event_id, e.type
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
spending_rates AS (
  SELECT event_id, type, 
         CAST(spent AS REAL) / CAST(amount AS REAL) as spending_rate
  FROM budget_with_event
  WHERE spent > 0 AND amount > 0
),
event_avg_rates AS (
  SELECT event_id, type, AVG(spending_rate) as event_avg_rate
  FROM spending_rates
  GROUP BY event_id, type
),
type_avg_rates AS (
  SELECT type, AVG(event_avg_rate) as type_avg_rate
  FROM event_avg_rates
  GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) as mean_value
  FROM type_avg_rates
)
SELECT 
  t.type,
  t.type_avg_rate as average_spending_rate,
  t.type_avg_rate / (SELECT mean_value FROM overall_mean) as rate_divided_by_mean
FROM type_avg_rates t
ORDER BY t.type
